⏺ Correct in effect, though the panel derives it rather than being told: the rail groups by path.basename(cwd) off the transcript
  (server/sessions.js:214), so "the folder the wrapper launched it in" is just what that resolves to. One consequence worth knowing —
  two different repos whose folders share a basename would silently merge into one group.
